title: DataLab
description: Sample data in any format (JSON, XML, YAML, CSV, key=value) and its transformations step by step: filter, sort, merge, compare and compute, with every step's result as a table.

title: Sweepito
description: Safely clean caches and build artifacts from inside VS Code. Runs natively, with no Python needed.

title: CAN Atlas
description: CAN DBC workbench: outline, hover, problems, frame decode and encode, bit layout. Pro: DBC diff, trace decode, statistics, documentation. Works offline; only the licence check uses the network.

title: Workspace Style
description: Identify with colors, badges, and prefixes which folder or repository each tab comes from in a multi-root workspace.

title: Gettext PO Editor & MO Viewer
description: Gettext editor for VS Code: open .po and .pot files as a translation table with untranslated and fuzzy filters, search, plural forms and the header, and save the same file with comments, obsolete entries and line wrapping kept. Compiled .mo files open read-only. Offline, no account.
